Southern India Drying Fastest, Study Flags Drought Hotspots

A 52-year study indicates that southern India is drying at the fastest rate, identifying several drought hotspots. The research highlights that the eastern coast of southern India experiences the most persistent drought conditions. The study analyzed data over five decades to map the changing patterns of drought across the region.
